summary: A small device you slide on the desk to move a pointer on the screen. It was shown publicly in 1968 but stayed rare until the Macintosh made it ordinary in 1984.

events.note: First shown in public, and offered for sale with one computer system the same year.

events.label: Xerox Star
events.note: Ships with the Xerox Star office computer.

events.label: Macintosh
events.note: The Macintosh brings the mouse to the mainstream.
